newsitem.title: FRANCE: CI-Telecom to invest 2.5 billion Ffr in 5-yrs.
newsitem.headline: CI-Telecom to invest 2.5 billion Ffr in 5-yrs.

text.p: France Telecom SA said Ivory Coast's CI-Telecom would invest over 2.5 billion francs in the coming five years to build 300,000 new lines, a quadrupling of the current network.

A consortium including France Telecom said earlier on Thursday it had won the privatisation tender to acquire a 51 percent stake in CI-Telecom. France Telecom said it would invest 1.05 billion francs.
France Telecom will also train CI-Telecom workers. The expansion programme will create 10,000 jobs in the Ivory Coast.
The French company will repay the Ivory Coast government 400 million francs in CI-Telecom debt.
